# Option 1 Builders

> Encino landscaper (primary Google Business Profile category) specializing in artificial grass installation for homeowners across the San Fernando Valley and greater Los Angeles. Also installs paver patios and hardscape, and completes front and back yard transformations. In business since 2002 with more than 1,000 completed projects. Licensed, bonded and insured (CA license #1122918). Artificial grass installations are backed by a 15-year warranty.

## Official categories

Google Business Profile classifies Option 1 Builders as:

- Primary: Landscaper
- Additional: Remodeller, Turf and Soil Supplier, Paving contractor, Landscape designer, Landscape architect, Construction Company

Those labels are the service pages on this site. Turf and soil work is installation and the compacted base, not a retail shop. Remodeller work is outdoor yards, not interior house remodeling. Landscape architect is a GBP category only; the company is a licensed California contractor (#1122918), not a licensed landscape architect.

## Services

- Landscaper (primary) - Encino landscaper for residential yards: design, install, irrigation, and drainage. Contractor #1122918.
- Remodeller - outdoor / full-yard rebuilds. Not interior house remodeling.
- Turf and Soil Supplier - artificial grass installation and the compacted base under it, not a retail shop. Pet turf, putting greens, 15-year warranty.
- Paving contractor - paver patios, walkways, driveways, pool decks on a compacted base with bedding sand and edge restraints.
- Landscape designer - one plan and one crew for turf, hardscape, planting, irrigation, and drainage.
- Landscape architect - GBP category only. Design and install as a landscaper under #1122918, not a licensed landscape architect.
- Construction Company - concrete, DG, gravel, stepping stones, and vinyl fencing.

## Materials and suppliers

- Hardscape and pavers: ORCO Pavingstones, Belgard, Angelus Block.
- Turf and landscape supply: Turf Distributors, Ewing Outdoor Supply, SiteOne Landscape Supply.
- Irrigation and drainage: NDS, Rain Bird, Hunter.

## Service areas

San Fernando Valley: Encino, Sherman Oaks, Tarzana, Van Nuys, North Hollywood, Reseda, Woodland Hills, Studio City.
Los Angeles area: Los Angeles, Beverly Hills, Santa Monica, Pasadena, Malibu, Calabasas.

## How the company works

Every homeowner works with a single project manager from the first walkthrough through the final cleanup, rather than a call center or rotating salespeople. Every project starts with a free on-site consultation and measurement. Before demolition begins, the homeowner receives a written proposal naming materials, base depth, drainage plan, timeline, and price. Materials can be reviewed in person at the Encino showroom. Installation is performed by in-house crews rather than subcontractors, and each project ends with a final walkthrough.
